title: Visual studio compile issue
body:
### Tested versions

current master branch

### System information

Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.21025.10016) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads)

### Issue description

After following the instructions for [compiling with visual studio](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/engine_details/development/compiling/compiling_for_windows.html#development-in-visual-studio), I get this compile error:
```

(compiler file 'msc1.cpp', line 1589)
```

### Steps to reproduce

I just followed the instructions for compiling in Visual Studio, using VS2022 (the recommended version). It fails to compile.
